### About Me

I am a full-stack developer, self-taught after graduating with a degree in Electrical and Electronics Engineering. From engineering to coding, I learned to connect physical sensors to digital code. For more information, check me out [here](https://www.raaedkabir.com/).

### Web App Development

JavaScript is my preferred stack, which lets me combine my two biggest passions, designing and coding, and makes me realize I could make a living out of something I enjoyed.

### Full-Stack Development

I started with back-end in Django with Python, then transitioned to the front-end, learning Vue along the way. I found it more rewarding to create websites I could see visually and embrace the design aspect I was looking for. I then returned to the back end with Node and serverless technologies on Amazon Web Services. I love using these new skills to create awesome things.
